first_sentence: 霧是地面附近的雲，因為空氣冷了。
facts: 霧是貼近地面的小水滴
空氣變冷，水氣就會變成小水滴
太陽出來後，霧慢慢會散掉
ask_back: 你猜早上的霧，等太陽出來會怎樣？

bridges.likes_cars: 霧很大的時候，汽車要開慢一點喔。

author: claude-haiku

question_patterns: why can't I see far in the fog
why is the air so foggy
en.first_sentence: Fog is a cloud near the ground, because the air got cold.
facts: Fog is tiny water drops sitting close to the ground.
When the air gets cold, water turns into tiny drops.
When the sun comes out, fog slowly goes away.
en.ask_back: Do you think fog is thicker in the morning, or at lunch?

bridges.likes_cars: You like cars! Do cars turn on their lights in thick fog?
